in_sanskrit.name: श्रीवत्स
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The mark of Shree (prosperity) with Vatsa (calf) or Vatsana (cow)

in_hindi.name: श्रीवत्स
in_hindi.meaning: वत्स (गाय के काँठ में ढिक्का) श्रीः (श्रेयस्कम्) के साथ

in_tamil.name: ஷ்ரீவத்தா
in_tamil.meaning: வட்டா (வட்டையல் அல்லது கோவையில் இருந்த கோழி) ஷ்ரீஷ் (ஷெய்யன்) களவும்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The mark of ஷ்ரீ (prosperity) with Vattam (calf) or Kovai (cow)

in_telugu.name: శ్రీవట్ట
in_telugu.long_meaning: The mark of శ్రీ (prosperity) with Vedamu (calf) or Seshamudam (bull)

in_marathi.name: Shrivatsa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrivatsa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shrivatsa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shrivatsa' which means 'God's Mark'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is believed to have a sacred mark named Shrivatsa on his chest. This mark is considered a symbol of divine grace and blessings.
